g.text: Finish A gunmetal satin · finish B matte black e-coat · leaf shape · ANIEZE debossed · drawn at 7 × scale
• Pull strength ≥ 70 N, smooth edges, no burrs
• Debossed ANIEZE logo (master vector) 0.3 mm deep, both faces
• Same finish lot as zips and snaps
Brass, nickel-free · A gunmetal satin / B matte black e-coat · 4 parts
• 10 sets: 9 on the storm flap (spacing SN = 13 cm at M) + 1 on the collar tab
• Fusible interfacing behind every cap and stud; holding strength ≥ 90 N
• Cap: smooth dome with a small debossed leaf (ANIEZE petal motif)
All zips metal, black tape · teeth and sliders A gunmetal / B matte black · ANIEZE leaf puller on every slider
Centre front: #5 metal, TWO-WAY open-end, 2 auto-lock sliders, metal stops · length ZF = 110 cm (M)
Hand pockets (2): #5 metal closed-end · 18 cm (19 cm XL–2XL)
Checks: nickel-free (EN 1811) · REACH · 24 h salt spray (ISO 9227) · approve one hardware card per finish (A gunmetal, B matte black) before bulk; B also passes an e-coat abrasion test.
